name: Coda
label: Coda API v1
description: Coda API v1 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/coda/api_spec.json). Official Coda API v1. Tokens are user-scoped. Official docs: https://coda.io/developers/apis/v1. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Coda official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"row_insert"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'row_insert', 'row_get', 'row_list', 'row_delete', 'row_update', 'column_get', 'column_list', 'control_get', 'formula_get', 'view_get', 'view_list', 'view_rows', 'push_button', 'push_view_button'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'row_insert'.

schema.label: doc_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `doc_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: table_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `table_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: row_insert, row_get, row_list, row_delete, row_update, column_get, column_list, control_get, formula_get, view_get, view_list, view_rows, push_button, push_view_button. Default: row_insert. Example: row_insert.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
